+name: Deploy to VPS
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - develop-docker
+
+jobs:
+  # ─── Job 1: Unit Test ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  test:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Setup PHP
+        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
+        with:
+          php-version: '8.3'
+          extensions: mbstring, pdo, pdo_mysql, redis, zip, gd, bcmath
+          coverage: none
+
+      - name: Copy .env for testing
+        run: cp .env.example .env
+
+      - name: Install Composer dependencies
+        run: composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader
+
+      - name: Generate app key
+        run: php artisan key:generate
+
+      - name: Run Unit Tests
+        run: php artisan test --testsuite=Unit
+
+  # ─── Job 2: Deploy (hanya jika test lulus) ───────────────────────────────────
+  deploy:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    needs: test  # tunggu job test selesai dan lulus
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout code
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Deploy to VPS via SSH
+        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.0.3
+        with:
+          host: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
+          username: ${{ secrets.SSH_USERNAME }}
+          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
+          script: |
+            cd ~/miftahul-ulum
+
+            echo "=== Pull latest code ==="
+            git pull origin develop-docker
+
+            echo "=== Build assets ==="
+            docker compose run --rm vite npm run build || true
+
+            echo "=== Rebuild PHP containers ==="
+            docker compose up --build -d app queue reverb
+
+            echo "=== Run migrations ==="
+            docker compose exec -T app php artisan migrate --force
+
+            echo "=== Clear & cache config ==="
+            docker compose exec -T app php artisan optimize:clear
+            docker compose exec -T app php artisan optimize
+
+            echo "=== Fix permissions ==="
+            docker compose exec -T app chmod -R 777 storage bootstrap/cache
+
+            echo "=== Done! ==="

commits.content:
name: Deploy to VPS

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to VPS via SSH
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.0.3
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.SSH_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.SSH_USERNAME }}
          key: ${{ secrets.SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd ~/miftahul-ulum

            echo "=== Pull latest code ==="
            git pull origin main

            echo "=== Build assets ==="
            docker compose exec -T vite npm run build || true

            echo "=== Rebuild PHP containers ==="
            docker compose up --build -d app queue reverb

            echo "=== Run migrations ==="
            docker compose exec -T app php artisan migrate --force

            echo "=== Clear & cache config ==="
            docker compose exec -T app php artisan optimize:clear
            docker compose exec -T app php artisan optimize

            echo "=== Fix permissions ==="
            docker compose exec -T app chmod -R 777 storage bootstrap/cache

            echo "=== Done! ==="
